headlines.title: Netanyahu defends Iran war, calls Gaza genocide accusations a lie in defiant U.N. address
headlines.description: As Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pleads his country’s case at the United Nations General Assembly, his target audience will likely be Israeli voters.

headlines.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters regain entry to White House
headlines.description: CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters have now been allowed back at the White House after a judge blocked President Trump’s ban. All three outlets had been turned away earlier in the day despite a judge’s order that the White House temporarily reinstate their access.

headlines.title: More Storms Flood New Mexico; East Coast Braces for Nor'easter
headlines.description: A rare September Nor’easter is strengthening and set to bring major flooding, high winds and torrential rain up and down the East Coast. Meanwhile, large sections of the Southwest are still soaked from days of downpours with muddy waters sweeping through the streets of New Mexico. NBC’s Sam Brock reports and TODAY’s Al Roker tracks the latest forecast.

headlines.title: Parents call for accountability in daughter’s death
headlines.description: NBC News’ Laura Jarrett reports for the series “The Cost of Denial” about a 21-year-old college student who went into the hospital for a broken ankle and ended up dying because of an over prescription of painkillers. Her parents say the system is broken and put part of the blame on the push for profit.

headlines.title: Bond yields surge to fresh two-decade highs but oil prices buffeted by Iran headlines
headlines.description: Key U.S. Treasury yields surged to fresh two-decade highs Thursday, as the price of oil returned to $105 per barrel.

headlines.title: These young quarterbacks were supposed to break out. Now they’re hurt.
headlines.description: The New York Giants’ Jaxson Dart on Monday became the latest upstart QB to be sidelined with an injury, joining the Bears’ Caleb Williams and the Commanders’ Jayden Daniels as signal callers who had to leave the field early in Week 2.

headlines.title: New data shows most women in the Marines passing toughened fitness tests for combat roles
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said he wanted women in combat roles to be held to the same physical standards as men. One year later, new numbers from the Marine Corps show most women in combat roles are meeting, or exceeding those standards. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: Error leads to backlog of tens of thousands of voter registration applications in Texas
headlines.description: Texas officials sent tens of thousands of delayed voter registration applications to county election officials this week after discovering an error, sparking a scramble to process them weeks out from the midterms.

headlines.title: Jim Copenhaver, man shot in Trump assassination attempt, dies 2 years later
headlines.description: A man who was injured two years ago in an assassination attempt on Donald Trump has died, according to a statement from his family on Thursday.

headlines.title: The 2028 implications of Michigan’s Senate race: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Jonathan Allen explains why Democrats with presidential aspirations will be paying close attention to the outcome of the Michigan Senate election.

headlines.title: Stanford apologizes saying AI-altered photo that changed student’s gender and race violated policy
headlines.description: Stanford University said the use of artificial intelligence to alter the race and appearance of students in a promotional photo violated its policy and was “a serious error in judgment.”

headlines.title: Ole Miss identifies 2 students found dead in cases that raise kratom concerns
headlines.description: The University of Mississippi named two undergrads, from Colorado and Georgia, as the students found dead in cases that sparked renewed concerns about kratom.
